description: This is historic. Our bill I wrote to wipe out local families’ medical debt was just signed into law! SB3025 begins the process of cancelling the medical debt of our local families, beginning with 50,000 Hawaii resident, wiping out $91 million of debt. People don’t choose medical debt.
